visualCharacteristics: About section: heading and clamped body with Show More / Show Less toggle next to an illustration.
contentPattern: One row: text cell (heading, body paragraphs, then "Show More" and "Show Less" as the last two paragraphs) | image cell.
usage: Use for an expandable about/intro text beside an image.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any long text + image pair needing a show more control.
